{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data and clean it
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
df_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rate within each customer segment and channel
grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])
segment_stats = grouped['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
segment_stats = segment_stats.rename(columns={'mean': 'conversion_rate', 'count': 'n'})

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
# email - paid_search, for each segment
diff_by_segment = segment_stats[segment_stats['channel'] == 'email'].copy()
diff_by_segment = diff_by_segment.merge(
    segment_stats[segment_stats['channel'] == 'paid_search'],
    on='customer_segment',
    suffixes=('_email', '_paid_search')
)
diff_by_segment['diff'] = diff_by_segment['conversion_rate_email'] - diff_by_segment['conversion_rate_paid_search']

# Compute overall weighted average difference by segment size in the full clean dataset
# Use the total segment size across both channels as weights
segment_total_n = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].count().to_dict()
diff_by_segment['weight'] = diff_by_segment['customer_segment'].map(segment_total_n)

total_n = diff_by_segment['weight'].sum()
diff_by_segment['weighted_diff'] = diff_by_segment['diff'] * (diff_by_segment['weight'] / total_n)

# Total adjusted difference
adjusted_diff = diff_by_segment['weighted_diff'].sum()

# Print results
print("Segment-level conversion rates:\n", segment_stats)
print("Segment-level differences:\n", diff_by_segment[['customer_segment', 'diff', 'weight', 'weighted_diff']])
print("Adjusted difference (email - paid_search):", adjusted_diff)"}
